from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document relevant to classification."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The unique title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The legal cause of action identified within the document, to be matched against the task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentInfo]
